_readme: The corpus both halves of the image lane are held to: src/core/imageCandidate.ts and
scraper/images.py must return the SAME key and the SAME refusal for every URL here.
Every entry is a real string taken from runs/acquired/ (the source is named), not an invented
one - a suite made only of clean inputs certifies the easy half of the problem.
key: what url_key() must return (null = not fetchable).
placeholder: the refusal placeholderReason() must give, or null when the URL is fetchable.
note: why this case is in the corpus.

cases.note: provantage, the ordinary case: a real product photo, upper-case extension
router-switch: a CATEGORY banner no substring can recognise. It is refused by the count rule (max_parts_per_url_key), not here - which is exactly why placeholder is null.
router-switch prints every photo twice; the transcode must give the SAME key as the line above or the lane spends two requests on one picture
meraki: the size lives in the query, so the query is dropped from the key and read as a hint instead
the same meraki file at a larger rendition: one candidate, and the lane must fetch THIS one
hpe-quickspecs prints the COMPANY LOGO in the same image block as the product shot
the product shot from the same page must NOT be refused: 'img' is not 'logo'
a file whose EXTENSION is a stripped segment name; the filename is never stripped
adversarial: rendition segments named like the file. Directories go, the filename stays.
a SERIES banner that is also the only photo Arista gives. No '/banner/' substring exists on purpose; the count rule decides.
Magento's own placeholder path, served with a 200 and a real JPEG body
layout spacer; a valid GIF that sniff() would happily accept
site chrome scraped as a product image
'catalog' contains 'log' but not 'logo': the substring list must not swallow every catalogue URL there is
an inline image is not something this lane can fetch and must never become a row
a relative src an adapter forgot to resolve
